description: SEO site audit: crawl up to 50 pages (fewer on the trial; up to 90 seconds) of a site from a start page by following internal links (then the sitemap), as a browser and respecting robots.txt. Reports broken and redirected internal links, duplicate titles and descriptions, orphan, deep and thin pages, sitemap entries that are noindex, redirect or name another canonical, and on-page SEO problems counted across pages. Needs an API key.

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

max_pages.description: How many pages to crawl, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

url.description: Start page of the crawl, usually the home page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are crawled.
url.title: Url

name: crawl_site
